_doc: SPEC_PET_ARENA §8.3.1 (Rev.6) — the handicap ladder: per-entrant stride multipliers, chosen at race setup, visible to everyone, recorded in the race header so replays reproduce. CLOSED set — race setup refuses a value off it; a free slider is how 'visible and honest' quietly becomes 1.37x and unexplainable. The names are the point: a child who accepts 'you get the rocket' has agreed to something they understand. At rocket (2.0) a younger sibling answering at half the rate holds even. Values are >= 1.0 (a handicap may only help) and 'none' (1.0) must exist — both guard-tested.
